authority: R5 Sky/Evening variants approved with generation-discrepancy documentation. The canonical docs/design/approved-ui-r3-r4.md contract overrides incidental raster differences.

shared.icons: Neutral structural/navigation roles; theme primary for actions/focus/selection; independent category and labeled status roles. The R4 arbitrary structural tint is corrected here.
shared.geometry: One shared header, field/card/icon-column and primary-button definition across atmosphere/appearance. Pixel dimensions, shaded fills and line wraps are illustrative; reading surfaces remain opaque.
shared.keyboard: Retain the canonical footer-aware focus/caret and single-inset-owner contract for every input, not just the pictured Title.
shared.atmosphere: Sky remains daytime clouds/lake in Dark; Evening remains sunset with sun in Dark. Fixture clocks are held constant; no automatic period boundaries/defaults/migration are approved.
shared.evidence: These twelve R4/R5 representatives are not every state in every appearance. Shared components must support all four atmospheres in Light/Dark; no extra screenshots or device passes are implied.

intentional: Neutral structural icons are already corrected from R4; green plant category and labeled confirmed Scheduled state remain distinct intentional roles.
Linked Due remains concise: Due at event start. Done completes work; Postpone alert changes only the next alert.
List has a navigation chevron. Read-only Schedule details uses circled information; editable Schedule options may use a gear.

corrections.observed: The ordinary-details scenic opening is taller than the other secondary samples; crop, toolbar spacing and title weight also vary.
corrections.resolve: Use one compact secondary opening, about 96 dp below the status inset including a 56 dp toolbar. Crop the shared atmosphere asset; reduce decoration first when height is constrained, preserving readable navigation and focused content.

corrections.observed: Ordinary Light details uses neutral icon tiles and stacked label/value rows; Dark overdue details uses mostly untiled icons and side-by-side columns.
corrections.resolve: Use shared details-card/icon-column/container/label-value anatomy in Light and Dark. Add the consequential independent Due row because of state, not appearance; grow/wrap and scroll instead of making a Dark-only layout.

corrections.observed: Postpone blue appears brighter than the filled Done blue.
corrections.resolve: Resolve both through the same Sky Light primary token, with outlined/filled styles and paired onPrimary. Do not sample separate per-screen PNG hex values.

checks: Verify shared 16 dp gutters/corners, 56 dp primary buttons, >=48 dp other targets, 16 sp values/14 sp support, actual contrast and TalkBack. Raster sizing is approximate, not measured component evidence.
Preserve Water plants, Home, full Event range and existing Notes; Scheduled represents confirmed scheduling, not guaranteed sound.

intentional: Amber Overdue and Due refer to unfinished work; neutral Alarm identifies the mode. Future postponement does not clear overdue.
